detected_fault: Intermittent wireless connectivity issues, stuttering in video and audio playback, display driver crashes, lagging mouse performance
suggested_solution: Run a thorough virus scan using MalwareBytes and ensure that Windows Firewall is enabled.
Update graphics drivers to the latest version.
Check for BIOS updates and apply them if available.
Monitor system temperatures and consider cleaning dust from the laptop's vents to prevent overheating.
Consider replacing the wireless card or adjusting settings to minimize interference.
